receipt_id.description: Stable id for this sealing receipt (UUID recommended).

policy_digest.description: Optional digest of the policy/module enabling sealing for this stream.

first_segment_id.description: First segment id included in this seal (if known).

last_segment_id.description: Last segment id included in this seal (if known).

segments_root_digest.description: Digest committing to the ordered set of segment digests sealed by this receipt (e.g., a Merkle root or JCS-hash of a normalized list).

hash_alg.description: Hash algorithm used for segments_root_digest (e.g., sha256).

previous_seal_digest.description: Optional digest of the previous seal receipt for this stream (digest chain).

interval_s.description: Optional sealing interval used by the sealer.

segments.description: Optional explicit list of segment digests (keep small; prefer segments_root_digest for large sets).

verification.description: Optional verification material hints. Verification keys should be exportable and pin-able, while sealing keys remain protected.

verification_key_digest.description: Digest of the verification key or verification key bundle (export-safe).

key_id.description: Key identifier used by the sealer (stable id, not a secret).

key_epoch.description: Monotonic key epoch / rotation counter (if applicable).
